sections.churn_summary: Across the five active churn_health books, hold-buffer guards are live (`exit_confirm_screens`: 2, `reentry_cooldown_screens`: 1, `min_rebalance_notional_gbp`: 10) but not visibly binding: every track shows `buffered_holdings`: 0, empty `exit_streak`, and `adjacent_flip_count`: 0 in the 7d window, with no `duplicate_day_skip` on the latest pass. Control `buy_tier_level` stays modest (`cost_drag`: 0.0084, `trade_count`: 131, 16 trades in 7d), while primary `ai_judgment_fair` remains the outlier (`cost_drag`: 0.1445, `trade_count`: 47, watch alert “Elevated primary-track cost drag”) despite the same guard stack. The 7d buffered-hold replay on primary and control shows tiny `cost_drag_delta_lower_minus_higher` (0.0001) with `trade_count_delta_lower_minus_higher` of −1 on primary and 0 on control—not evidence that tightening exit_confirm further would fix drag at scale. The single biggest operational learning gap is separating primary lifetime churn economics (14.45% drag) from guard mechanics: epoch-scoped primary `cost_drag` is already 0.0266 on 37 post-epoch trades with `benchmark_span_available`: true, while matched-30 twins run similar guards at ~0.007 drag—suggesting book construction and rotation, not hold-buffer state, drive the primary alert.

sections.proposed_experiments:
1. [paper_churn] Buffered-hold 1 vs 2 replay on `ai_judgment_matched30_fair` and `buy_tier_matched30_fair` over ≥7d logged passes — expected learning value: confirm whether B3 shadows mirror control’s tied `trade_count_delta` / ~0.0001 `cost_drag_delta` or show rotation-driven divergence (buy_tier_matched30_fair already has 12 full exits in 7d). Align with completed evidence chain from plr-20260901-02 without reopening that task.

2. [offline_sim] Archive-lab full-period rebalance replay for `ai_judgment_fair` (L111 gap) — expected learning value: reconcile lifetime `cost_drag` 0.1445 and `total_costs` 144.47 with epoch `cost_drag` 0.0266 and thin 7d replay (5 log entries), per counterfactual limitations on pre-logging history. Execute under open task ldr-20260823-03.

3. [monitoring] Exit-shadow thickness watch on active books, prioritising `ai_judgment_fair` (`open_count` 18, `closed_count` 0) against 4 `full_exits_in_window` in churn — expected learning value: learn whether screen-rotation vs grace drives primary exits before any guard retune; prerequisite per ana-20260728-04.
